summary: Added meterbill/money.py (exact integer rounding, no decimal context) and routed all rounding/fixed-place formatting through it; removed the context line from __init__.py. Batch worker threads previously ran with half-even context rounding, so charge_bands/compute/effective_price got a keyword-only method (batch passes HALF_EVEN) to keep output identical; outputs matched the original on ~800 generated commands. Quirks kept as-is: VAT half-even vs half-up elsewhere, batch half-even band/eff-price rounding, whole-cash zero printed as 0.
